definitions: A short, simple description of a feature told from the perspective of the person who desires the new capability, usually a user or customer of the system.
A tool used in agile software development to capture a description of a software feature from an end-user perspective.
examples: We need to write a user story for this new feature.
Each user story should be small enough to be completed within a single sprint.
The product owner is responsible for prioritizing the user story backlog.
